title: Ignoring a nullable return cannot make a null dereference safe

ground_truth.statement: maybe(false) returns null and its unguarded value() call throws Error. The true branch returns 7. Nullsafe calls cover both outcomes without throwing.

provenance.note: The source uses @psalm-ignore-nullable-return and random selection. Removed that analyzer-only override, used an explicit bool for deterministic controls, and retained the nullable factory followed by a method call.

notes: Measures the underlying nullable operation rather than suppression portability. All three tools diagnose the unsafe call at line 5 and leave the nullsafe control clean. Mago's measured code is possible-method-access-on-null. The source being accepted under an explicit ignore annotation is not an oracle of runtime safety.
